name: qkd_pv16_vport_r5
purpose: Q-ATTN-RATE 2026-10-16: PV16 V port of the KV die (16 per die, ONE master). Replaces the 8-sector double-buffered transposer: with the VMAP=1 V placement each w16 port reads only groups {lane,0}/{lane,1}, every PC streams in the controller's v_consumer_order; the port is a static 2:1 quad select with input + output pin registers and tag checks. Pin-bound (3,276 pins, ~1,230 um2 of cells): 86.4 x 172.8 is the smallest outline at ~6 pins/um per face.

job.purpose: r5 (Q-VMWB 10-16): the vport is also the V issuer -- the pvw pair's request (pr_*) is demuxed by t[0] onto the landing V get face (vq0/vq1 -> qkd_static_kv_landing_physical_grp VREQ=1) and slot/sel come from a fixed delay (RL 19, WP 2, RT 8 -> 5-edge request wait), so the die needs no calendar producer and no glue; rsp face per side {valid, v, t, 1024-b} (r4); HB1 output pad (r2 native launch 220.23 on one pin) and rst_n pin capture (r1). 0 production cycles.

reroute_reason.why: port ABI + V issuer (940b368bf); r2 native FAIL launch 220.23 (results/arch/qwen_attention_rate_1015/native_pv16_vport_r2_0600.json)

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every port at the module boundary: every input (slot/sel/in_v*/in_t*/in_d*) -> *_q, every output (out_valid/out_t/out_v/fault) a flop
